DAM-47: refactor camellia ui with shadcn preset surfaces (#49)

## Summary
- add a persisted `shadcn-ui` style preset to camellia so visual treatment is no longer tied to individual routes
- refactor the shared shell, dashboard, playground, template/specification/content list pages, and the full remaining system and user route families onto the preset-driven shadcn composition baseline
- normalize hidden and detail-heavy flows such as notification, feedback detail, agreement, explanation, size-range, and user dialogs to shared `Card`-based surfaces while keeping existing route behavior and loaders intact

## Validation
